events.title: George Thorogood and The Destroyers
events.venueName: Gila River Resorts and Casinos, Wild Horse Pass
events.venueAddress: 5040 Wild Horse Pass Blvd, Chandler, AZ 85226
events.description: Blues rock veteran George Thorogood and The Destroyers bring their catalog of hits, including Bad to the Bone, to Gila River Resorts and Casinos at Wild Horse Pass. The show plays the resort's live entertainment venue near Chandler.

events.title: Gene Simmons Band
events.venueName: Salt River Grand Ballroom at Talking Stick Resort
events.venueAddress: 9800 E Talking Stick Way, Scottsdale, AZ 85256
events.description: KISS frontman Gene Simmons leads his solo band through a career spanning set in the Salt River Grand Ballroom at Talking Stick Resort. The intimate ballroom show is a rare solo outing for the rock icon in the Valley.

events.title: John Mellencamp: Dancing Words Tour, The Greatest Hits
events.description: John Mellencamp brings his Dancing Words Tour to Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre, performing a career spanning greatest hits set that includes Jack and Diane, Small Town and Pink Houses. Several songs return to his live set for the first time in more than a decade.

events.title: Lionel Richie & Earth, Wind & Fire: Sing a Song All Night Long
events.description: Lionel Richie and Earth, Wind & Fire co-headline a stop on their Sing a Song All Night Long tour at the Mortgage Matchup Center. The show features decades of R&B and soul hits from both acts, part of a 26 city North American run produced by Live Nation.

events.title: Megan Moroney: Cloud 9 Tour
events.description: Country singer Megan Moroney brings her Cloud 9 Tour to the Valley, performing hits that blend traditional country storytelling with modern pop sensibility. The show plays Desert Diamond Arena on Tuesday, August 11, 2026.

events.title: Southeast Arizona Birding Festival
events.time: Times vary by field trip and program
events.venueName: DoubleTree by Hilton Tucson - Reid Park
events.description: The Tucson Bird Alliance hosts guided field trips, photography workshops and a free nature expo featuring live animals from Reid Park Zoo. The festival highlights southeastern Arizona's monsoon season specialty birds, including coppery tailed trogons and five striped sparrows.

events.title: August Doin's Rodeo - World's Oldest Continuous Rodeo
events.description: Payson's August Doin's, billed as the World's Oldest Continuous Rodeo, has run every year since 1884. Expect pro rodeo performances, a parade and small-town Western festivities in Arizona's cool Rim Country.

events.title: Meghan Trainor: The Get In Girl Tour
events.description: Meghan Trainor brings The Get In Girl Tour to downtown Phoenix in support of her seventh album, Toy With Me, with Icona Pop opening. A portion of proceeds benefits The Trevor Project.

events.title: Kane Brown with Caylee Hammack
events.venueName: AVA Amphitheater at Casino Del Sol
events.description: Country star Kane Brown brings his high road tour to the open air AVA Amphitheater, with support from Caylee Hammack. The venue seats up to 5,000 guests at the Casino Del Sol resort.

events.title: Santana & The Doobie Brothers: Oneness Tour 2026
events.description: Rock legends Santana and The Doobie Brothers co-headline a stop on their Oneness Tour at the Mortgage Matchup Center in downtown Phoenix. The Live Nation produced tour pairs decades of classic rock hits from both acts.

events.title: Arizona Toy Con Glendale
events.description: Arizona Toy Con returns to the Glendale Civic Center with more than 100 tables of vintage and modern toys, trading cards, comics and other collectibles. General admission is 10 dollars, with kids 10 and under free.

events.title: Ne-Yo & Akon: Nights Like This Tour 2026
events.description: R&B artists Ne-Yo and Akon co-headline a tour stop at Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre, performing their catalogs of 2000s hits. The outdoor show includes lawn and reserved seating options.

events.title: Mother Road Classic Car Show
events.description: The Route 66 Car Club of Flagstaff hosts its annual charity car show in the tree lined areas near City Hall and Wheeler Park, part of Route 66's centennial celebrations. Proceeds support local Flagstaff charities.

events.title: Django Festival Allstars
events.description: Gypsy jazz ensemble Django Festival Allstars perform at La Rosa, a live music venue in a restored former Benedictine church in midtown Tucson. The group carries on the Django Reinhardt string swing tradition with virtuosic guitar and violin playing.

events.title: Noah Kahan: The Great Divide Tour
events.description: Singer-songwriter Noah Kahan brings The Great Divide Tour to Chase Field in downtown Phoenix, with support from Gigi Perez and Annabelle Dinda. The stadium show follows the folk pop artist's breakout success with Stick Season.

events.title: Train: Drops of Jupiter, 25 Years in the Atmosphere
events.description: Train marks the 25th anniversary of their breakthrough album with a tour stop at Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre, joined by Barenaked Ladies and Matt Nathanson. The 38 plus city North American tour runs from July through August 2026.

events.title: Grand Canyon Music Festival
events.venueName: Shrine of the Ages, Grand Canyon South Rim
events.venueAddress: South Entrance Rd, Grand Canyon Village, AZ 86023
events.description: The 43rd season of this chamber music festival brings world-class ensembles, including the Manhattan Chamber Players, to the South Rim of the Grand Canyon August 21 through September 6, 2026.

events.title: Watermelon and Sweet Corn Festival at Mortimer Farms
events.description: This two day harvest festival at Mortimer Farms near Prescott lets visitors ride the Grain Train out to the fields to pick their own sweet corn, then sample roasted corn, sweet corn ice cream and fresh watermelon. Family activities include a Corny Game Show with a corn eating contest and a watermelon spitting contest.

events.title: Arizona Cardinals Preseason vs. Dallas Cowboys
events.description: The Cardinals host the Dallas Cowboys in their lone home preseason game of 2026 at State Farm Stadium, ahead of the regular season opener against Seattle in September.

events.title: Tori Amos: In Times of Dragons Tour
events.description: Tori Amos brings her In Times of Dragons Tour to downtown Phoenix with support from Bartees Strange, performing songs from her new album alongside highlights from her 35 year career. She is joined by longtime collaborators Jon Evans and Ash Soan plus three backing vocalists.

events.title: Arizona Diamondbacks vs. Chicago Cubs
events.description: The Diamondbacks open a home series against the Chicago Cubs at Chase Field. The late August matchup comes during a stretch of key divisional and interleague games for Arizona.

events.title: Zayn Malik: The Konnakol Tour
events.description: Former One Direction member Zayn Malik plays downtown Phoenix's Mortgage Matchup Center (formerly Footprint Center) on his Konnakol Tour, supporting his fifth solo studio album.

events.title: Avenged Sevenfold and Good Charlotte: North American Tour 2026
events.description: Metal heavyweights Avenged Sevenfold co-headline with pop-punk veterans Good Charlotte on a stop of their 2026 North American tour. The outdoor amphitheatre show is set for Thursday, August 27, 2026.

events.title: Phoenix Street Eats & Food Truck Festival
events.description: A three day downtown Phoenix gathering of food trucks and local vendors serving up a wide range of street food. The family friendly event runs across a full weekend at Hance Park in the heart of the city.

events.title: KAROL G: Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour
events.description: Colombian superstar KAROL G brings her Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour to State Farm Stadium on August 29, 2026. The stadium stop is part of her global arena and stadium tour supporting her latest album.

events.title: Hopi Arts & Cultural Festival
events.time: Sat 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Sun 11:00 AM - 5:00 PM
events.description: The 15th annual Hopi Arts and Cultural Festival brings award winning Hopi artists from the twelve Hopi villages to Flagstaff Mall to share arts, culture and education. Visitors can browse artist booths featuring pottery, jewelry, weaving and carving, along with dance and music performances.

events.title: Night Trip Festival Arizona
events.description: This Insomniac produced house and techno festival transforms WestWorld of Scottsdale into a club style outdoor event with high fidelity sound and stage production. The 2026 lineup includes Cloonee, Dombresky, Jackie Hollander, Matroda and Walker and Royce.

events.title: Arizona Diamondbacks vs. Philadelphia Phillies
events.description: The Diamondbacks host the Philadelphia Phillies for a three-game series at Chase Field over Labor Day weekend. MLB has billed the matchup as one of the season's marquee series for Arizona.

events.title: Chicago & Styx: The Windy Cities Tour
events.description: Classic rock bands Chicago and Styx, both of whom formed in the Windy City decades ago, join forces on a co-headlining arena tour. The show stops at the Mortgage Matchup Center on Tuesday, September 1, 2026.

events.title: Coconino County Fair
events.description: Northern Arizona's largest county fair returns to Fort Tuthill over Labor Day weekend with carnival rides, livestock shows, live entertainment and fair food in the cool pines of Flagstaff.

events.title: Tucson Comic-Con
events.description: Tucson's long running pop culture convention returns with comics, gaming, cosplay, celebrity guests and local vendors filling the downtown convention center. The three day event has grown steadily since it began in 2008.

events.title: ASU Sun Devils Football Home Opener vs. Morgan State
events.description: Arizona State opens its 2026 home football season against Morgan State at Mountain America Stadium in Tempe. Big 12 home games against Baylor, Kansas State, Colorado and Oklahoma State follow through November.

events.title: Zach Bryan: With Heaven On Tour
events.description: Singer-songwriter Zach Bryan brings his biggest tour yet to State Farm Stadium on Saturday, September 5, 2026. The stadium show is one of the largest stops on his 2026 North American run.

events.title: My Chemical Romance: The Black Parade 2026
events.description: My Chemical Romance perform a stadium show at Chase Field marking 20 years since The Black Parade, with Mesa natives Jimmy Eat World as the supporting act. This is a rare Arizona stadium date for the band.

events.title: Navajo Nation Fair
events.description: The 78th Annual Navajo Nation Fair, the largest American Indian fair in North America, celebrates Dine culture with rodeo, pow wow, traditional song and dance, and the Miss Navajo Nation pageant.

events.title: Desert Botanical Garden Community Day
events.description: A pay what you can admission day makes the Desert Botanical Garden accessible to more Valley families, with visitors invited to pay any amount that works for them. The garden's desert plant collections and trails are open for self guided exploration.

events.title: Shaboozey: Outlaws Never Die Tour
events.description: Grammy nominated Shaboozey kicks off his headlining Outlaws Never Die Tour in downtown Phoenix, with support from Brittney Spencer. The show supports his latest album of outlaw country and hip hop influenced tracks.

events.title: Goldrush Music Festival: Midnight Riders
events.venueAddress: 5700 W North Loop Rd, Chandler, AZ 85226
events.description: A two day, 18 and up electronic music festival at Rawhide Western Town featuring headliners Alesso, Deadmau5, Martin Garrix and GRiZ among more than two dozen artists across multiple stages. The event pairs desert nightlife with a Western Town backdrop.

events.title: Rodeo Scottsdale: The West's Most Western Rodeo
events.description: A three day indoor, climate controlled rodeo bringing professional bull riding, barrel racing and other Western rodeo events to WestWorld of Scottsdale. The event blends competitive rodeo action with Western themed entertainment for the whole family.

events.title: MANA: Vivir Sin Aire Tour
events.description: Grammy winning Latin rock band Mana bring their Vivir Sin Aire Tour to downtown Phoenix, performing decades of Spanish language rock hits. The band remains one of the best selling Latin acts of all time.

events.title: Flagstaff Music Festival
events.description: A free, all day showcase of local Flagstaff bands in downtown's Heritage Square, held to raise funds and awareness for the Haven Walker Music Scholarship Fund.

events.title: Chance The Rapper: Coloring Book 10 Year Anniversary Tour
events.description: Chance The Rapper marks ten years since his breakout mixtape Coloring Book with an anniversary tour stop in downtown Phoenix. The Grammy winning project helped define the modern independent artist model.

events.title: Motley Crue: The Return of the Carnival of Sins
events.description: Glam metal icons Motley Crue return to Phoenix as part of their Carnival of Sins tour. The show at Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre is set for Wednesday, September 16, 2026.

events.title: Arizona Restaurant Week (Fall)
events.description: Restaurants across Arizona offer prix-fixe dinner menus at $33, $44 or $55 during this statewide 10-day dining celebration. Participating restaurants and menus are announced by September 1.

events.title: Arizona Diamondbacks vs. New York Yankees
events.description: The Diamondbacks host the New York Yankees for a rare interleague series at Chase Field, a marquee matchup expected to draw large crowds. The series opens Friday, September 18 and runs through Sunday, September 20, 2026.

events.title: Southwest Flow Festival
events.description: A family friendly camping festival built around movement and creativity, with flow arts, fire spinning, circus arts, yoga and dance workshops, plus nighttime sets inside a 65 foot geodesic dome.

events.title: Pickin' in the Pines Bluegrass and Acoustic Music Festival
events.venueName: Pepsi Amphitheater at Fort Tuthill County Park
events.venueAddress: Fort Tuthill County Park, Flagstaff, AZ 86005
events.description: This 20th anniversary edition brings three days of bluegrass, jamgrass and roots music to the Pepsi Amphitheater at Fort Tuthill County Park, with four nights of camping among the pines. The festival has repeatedly been voted Flagstaff's best.

events.title: Prescott Indian Art Market
events.time: Sat 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Sun 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM
events.description: The Sharlot Hall Museum hosts this annual celebration of Native American art and culture, featuring dozens of Indigenous artists from across the Southwest. Visitors can browse painting, jewelry, pottery and textiles while watching live cultural demonstrations.

events.title: Arizona Diamondbacks vs. New York Yankees
events.description: The Diamondbacks host the New York Yankees for an interleague series at Chase Field in mid-September. It is one of the headline interleague matchups on Arizona's 2026 home schedule.

events.title: Arizona Cardinals Home Opener vs. Seattle Seahawks
events.description: The Cardinals open their 2026 home schedule against the Seattle Seahawks at State Farm Stadium. Home dates against the Lions, Broncos, Rams and Commanders follow through the fall.

events.title: Kehlani World Tour
events.description: R&B singer Kehlani brings the Kehlani World Tour to Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre in support of a new album, with support from Durand Bernarr, Isaia Huron, TheARTI$T, Odeal and Waseel.

events.title: Flagstaff Festival of Science
events.description: The 37th annual Flagstaff Festival of Science offers ten days of free lectures, open houses, star parties and hands-on STEM activities. The 2026 theme, Driven by Curiosity, also celebrates the Route 66 centennial.

events.title: Usher and Chris Brown: The R&B Tour
events.description: R&B superstars Usher and Chris Brown co-headline a stadium stop on their North American tour at State Farm Stadium in Glendale. The show is part of a run billed as the R&B Tour.

events.title: Empire of the Sun with Polo & Pan
events.description: Australian electronic duo Empire of the Sun headlines Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre with support from Polo and Pan and Midnight Generation. The stop is part of the act's 2026 North American tour.

events.title: Usher & Chris Brown: The R&B Tour
events.description: R&B stars Usher and Chris Brown co-headline The R&B Tour at State Farm Stadium in Glendale. The stadium stop is part of a 2026 North American run billed as Raymond and Brown.

events.title: Arizona State Fair
events.description: The Arizona State Fair returns October 1 through November 1, 2026 with the theme A State of Wonder, featuring carnival rides, concerts, fried fair food, livestock exhibits and midway games, Thursdays through Sundays.

events.title: Flagstaff Star Party
events.description: The Flagstaff Dark Skies Coalition hosts three nights of free public stargazing at Buffalo Park, taking advantage of Flagstaff status as the world first International Dark Sky Place. Telescopes and astronomy educators are on hand each evening from 6 to 10 PM.

events.title: Sedona Yoga Festival
events.description: This four-day wellness conference brings yoga, meditation and Ayurveda sessions, keynote talks and sound healing workshops to venues around Sedona. More than 150 sessions are offered across the weekend for practitioners of all levels.

events.title: Gin Blossoms: Arizona State Fair Coliseum Concert Series
events.description: Tempe formed rock band Gin Blossoms kick off the Arizona State Fair's 2026 Coliseum Concert Series with a full headlining set. The reserved seating show includes fair admission.

events.title: Sedona WagFest & Fair
events.description: The City of Sedona's 7th annual WagFest & Fair is a free, family friendly day for dogs and their owners, with vendor booths, an agility course, a pet parade and raffle prizes. Interactive demonstrations and games run throughout the event.

events.title: Four Peaks Oktoberfest
events.venueAddress: 80 W Rio Salado Pkwy, Tempe, AZ 85281
events.description: Arizona's biggest Oktoberfest takes over Tempe Beach Park with Four Peaks beer, German food, live polka and rock bands, carnival rides and stein-holding contests along Tempe Town Lake.

events.title: Sedona Arts Festival
events.time: Sat 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Sun 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM
events.venueAddress: 995 Upper Red Rock Loop Rd, Sedona, AZ 86336
events.description: This juried fine art festival brings more than 100 artists to Sedona each October, with painting, sculpture, jewelry, ceramics and photography set against red rock views.

events.title: Phoenix Suns Preseason vs. San Antonio Spurs
events.description: The Phoenix Suns host the reigning Western Conference champion San Antonio Spurs in a preseason matchup at Mortgage Matchup Center. It is one of two home preseason games on the Suns' 2026 exhibition schedule.

events.title: Tucson Meet Yourself Folklife Festival
events.description: This free three-day folklife festival gathers more than 500 artists, musicians, dancers and cooks who share the foods, crafts and traditions of southern Arizona's many cultural communities.

events.title: The Offspring: Arizona State Fair Coliseum Concert Series
events.description: Alt-rock veterans The Offspring headline the Arizona State Fair's Coliseum Concert Series with a full set of their hits. The reserved seating show includes fair admission, no opening act.

events.title: Sedona Plein Air Festival
events.description: The 22nd annual Sedona Plein Air Festival brings painters from across the country to capture the red rock landscape on location around Sedona and the Verde Valley. Public events from October 19 through 24 include paint-outs, artist demonstrations and an awards ceremony, followed by a gallery exhibition at the Sedona Arts Center.

events.title: Phoenix Suns Preseason vs. Utah Jazz
events.description: The Suns close out their five game preseason slate at home against the Utah Jazz at Mortgage Matchup Center. It is the second of two home exhibition games on the 2026 schedule.

events.title: Phoenix Pride Festival and Parade
events.time: Sat 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM, Sun 12:00 PM - 9:00 PM
events.venueAddress: 300 E Indian School Rd, Phoenix, AZ 85012
events.description: One of the Southwest's largest LGBTQ+ celebrations features performers across multiple stages, hundreds of vendors and exhibitors, and the Pride Parade down 3rd Street on Sunday morning.

events.title: Fest of Fall
events.description: The City of Sedona's third annual Fest of Fall fills Posse Grounds Park with food trucks, local vendors, a pickleball tournament, cornhole tournament and a kids' zone. Live music runs into the evening alongside beer and food for purchase.

events.title: NASCAR Cup Series Freeway Insurance 500
events.description: NASCAR playoff racing returns to Phoenix Raceway as the Freeway Insurance 500 opens the Cup Series Round of 8 on October 18, 2026, capping a full race weekend in Avondale.

events.title: Gorillaz: The Mountain Tour
events.description: Gorillaz bring The Mountain Tour to downtown Phoenix, with support from Little Simz and Deltron 3030. The virtual band's stadium and arena shows are known for elaborate animated visuals paired with live performance.

events.title: Public Enemy: Arizona State Fair Coliseum Concert Series
events.description: Hip hop pioneers Public Enemy bring a full headlining set to the Arizona State Fair's Coliseum Concert Series. The reserved seating show includes fair admission, no opening act.

events.title: Spooky Safari at the Phoenix Zoo
events.description: The Phoenix Zoo Halloween event offers trick-or-treating stations, an hourly costume parade, animal encounters and Halloween themed crafts across three evenings. Tickets are 18 dollars per person and children age 2 and under are admitted free.

events.title: Quilt, Craft & Sewing Festival
events.description: This multi-day trade show brings sewing machine dealers, quilting tool vendors, fabric sellers and craft suppliers to the Tucson Expo Center. Admission and parking are free, running Thursday and Friday from 10 AM to 5 PM and Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM.

events.title: Canal Convergence: Water + Art + Light
events.description: Scottsdale's free public art festival marks its 15th anniversary with ten nights of large-scale, light-based art installations along the Arizona Canal, plus live music, workshops and artist talks.

events.title: Southern Arizona Blues Heritage Festival
events.description: The Southern Arizona Blues Heritage Foundation biggest event of the year fills the bandshell area of Kennedy Park with a full day of live blues performances. The family friendly festival also includes food and craft vendors.

events.title: All Souls Procession
events.description: More than 150,000 participants join this two-mile, human-powered procession honoring departed loved ones, inspired by Dia de los Muertos and culminating in the ceremonial burning of the Urn.

events.title: Fall Fountain Festival of Fine Arts & Crafts
events.time: Fri-Sat 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Sun 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM
events.venueAddress: Avenue of the Fountains, Fountain Hills, AZ 85268
events.description: Held the second full weekend of November for over 50 years, this free juried festival brings hundreds of artists and artisans to downtown Fountain Hills beside one of the world's tallest fountains.

events.title: Christmas at the Princess
events.description: The Fairmont Scottsdale Princess transforms into a desert winter wonderland with millions of lights, a Christmas tree lagoon show, ice skating and train rides. The event runs nightly from the week before Thanksgiving through early January each year.

events.title: El Tour de Tucson
events.description: The 43rd El Tour de Tucson, one of America's largest charity cycling events, draws thousands of riders to loop courses around Tucson on Saturday, November 21, 2026, with distances for all abilities.

events.title: Dial Up Festival
events.description: This new traveling festival celebrates late 1990s and early 2000s music and culture, with Nelly and Sugar Ray headlining a lineup that also includes Smash Mouth, Alien Ant Farm, Warren G, Paul Wall and Unwritten Law. The single day event runs from early afternoon into the evening with themed bars, vendors and photo ops.

events.title: ZooLights at the Phoenix Zoo
events.description: The Phoenix Zoo's beloved holiday tradition features millions of twinkling lights, glowing animal lanterns and lakeside light shows. ZooLights runs nightly from late November through mid-January each season.

events.title: Glendale Glitters
events.description: Nearly one million holiday lights illuminate 12 blocks of Historic Downtown Glendale's Old Towne and Catlin Court districts, with free weekend performances at Murphy Park. Lights glow nightly from the Friday after Thanksgiving through early January.

events.title: Tempe Festival of the Arts
events.time: Fri-Sat 10:00 AM - 5:30 PM, Sun 10:00 AM - 4:30 PM
events.description: The 58th Fall Tempe Festival of the Arts fills downtown Mill Avenue with hundreds of juried artist booths, street performers, local food and a beer and wine garden. Admission is free.

events.title: Vrbo Fiesta Bowl - College Football Playoff Quarterfinal
events.description: The Vrbo Fiesta Bowl hosts a College Football Playoff quarterfinal at State Farm Stadium on December 30, 2026, the only CFP game played that day, giving Arizona an exclusive national spotlight.

events.title: Rock 'n' Roll Running Series Arizona
events.description: Thousands of runners take on the marathon, half marathon, 10K and 5K with live bands lining courses through Phoenix and Tempe. The marathon runs Sunday, January 17, 2027, finishing near ASU in Tempe.

events.title: Quartzsite Sports, Vacation & RV Show
events.description: Known simply as The Big Tent, this nine-day show is the centerpiece of Quartzsite's massive winter RV gathering, with hundreds of vendors serving the hundreds of thousands of RVers who descend on the desert town each January.

events.title: Havasu Balloon Festival and Fair
events.venueAddress: 699 London Bridge Rd, Lake Havasu City, AZ 86403
events.description: Dozens of hot air balloons fill the sky over Lake Havasu during this four-day festival featuring mass ascensions, evening balloon glows, a carnival, vendors and live entertainment near the London Bridge.

events.title: Barrett-Jackson Scottsdale Collector Car Auction
events.description: The World's Greatest Collector Car Auction returns to WestWorld of Scottsdale January 23-31, 2027, with more than a thousand collector cars crossing the block plus exhibits, thrill rides and automotive lifestyle displays.

events.title: Arizona Renaissance Festival
events.venueAddress: 12601 E US Highway 60, Gold Canyon, AZ 85118
events.description: A 16th-century European village springs to life east of Apache Junction with jousting knights, artisan shops, 13 stages of entertainment and giant turkey legs. Open weekends February 6 through April 4, 2027, plus Presidents' Day Monday.

events.title: WM Phoenix Open
events.description: The Greatest Show on Grass brings the PGA TOUR and the world's rowdiest golf hole, the stadium-seated 16th, to TPC Scottsdale February 8-14, 2027, with tournament rounds Thursday through Sunday.

events.title: Tucson Gem & Mineral Show
events.description: The flagship show of the world-famous Tucson Gem, Mineral & Fossil Showcase runs February 11-14, 2027 at the Tucson Convention Center, capping weeks of citywide gem shows that begin in late January.

events.title: Scottsdale Arabian Horse Show
events.description: Nearly 2,400 of the world's finest Arabian horses compete over 11 days at WestWorld in this signature Scottsdale event, which also features shopping expos, demonstrations and family activities.

events.title: Wickenburg Gold Rush Days & Senior Pro Rodeo
events.description: Wickenburg's 77th annual Gold Rush Days celebrates the town's mining heritage with a senior pro rodeo, parade, carnival, gold panning and artisan fair over Presidents' Day weekend.

events.title: Cactus League Spring Training
events.description: Fifteen MLB teams, including the Diamondbacks, Cubs and Dodgers, play spring training baseball at ten ballparks around the Valley. Games traditionally begin the third weekend of February and run through late March; the official 2027 schedule is released in fall 2026.

events.title: Tucson Rodeo - La Fiesta de los Vaqueros
events.description: One of the top 25 professional rodeos in North America, La Fiesta de los Vaqueros runs February 20-28, 2027 and includes the Tucson Rodeo Parade, billed as the world's longest non-motorized parade, on February 25.

events.title: Innings Festival
events.venueAddress: 80 W Rio Salado Pkwy, Tempe, AZ 85281
events.description: This baseball-meets-music festival returns to Tempe Beach Park February 26-28, 2027 with three stages of rock, pop and indie acts plus MLB player appearances, timed to the start of spring training.

events.title: Lost Dutchman Days Rodeo & Carnival
events.venueAddress: 1590 E Lost Dutchman Blvd, Apache Junction, AZ 85119
events.description: Apache Junction's signature celebration beneath the Superstition Mountains features three days of pro rodeo, a 30-ride carnival and a downtown parade on Saturday morning, February 27.

events.title: Heard Museum Guild Indian Fair & Market
events.time: Sat 9:30 AM - 5:00 PM, Sun 9:30 AM - 4:00 PM
events.description: The 69th annual Indian Fair & Market gathers hundreds of the nation's most acclaimed American Indian artists at the Heard Museum, with juried art, music, dance performances and Native foods.

events.title: Celebrate Sedona
events.description: This free monthly gathering in the Sedona Arts Center upper parking lot celebrates local arts, food and drink with live music. The August edition coincides with the opening of the Beyond the Frame exhibition and a SAC ceramics demo and sale.

events.title: Flagstaff Art in the Park (Labor Day Show)
events.time: Sat-Sun 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Mon 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM
events.description: This locally owned, juried arts and crafts festival brings about 80 artists from across the Southwest to downtown Flagstaff for Labor Day weekend. The free event includes live music, food vendors and a beer garden with local and regional breweries.

events.title: FoodieLand Food Festival: Phoenix
events.time: Fri 3:00 PM - 10:00 PM, Sat-Sun 1:00 PM - 10:00 PM
events.description: More than 200 vendors serve global street food, artisan sweets and drinks at this three day food festival at Phoenix Raceway. The event also features games and live music, with free admission for children 5 and under.

events.title: Disney Worlds Collide Concert Tour
events.description: This arena production brings together the worlds of Descendants, ZOMBIES and, for the first time, Camp Rock, with a cast of Disney stars performing mashups and fan favorite songs. The show features full choreography, special effects and fan interaction segments.

events.title: BABYMETAL World Tour 2026 with Halestorm and Violent Vira
events.description: Japanese metal act BABYMETAL brings its World Tour to Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre, blending J-pop, rock and metal, with support from Halestorm and Violent Vira. The outdoor show is part of a broader 2026 North and Latin American run.

events.title: Wu-Tang Forever: The Final Chamber Tour
events.description: Wu-Tang Clan closes out its Final Chamber Tour with a stop at Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre in Phoenix. The Live Nation produced show caps a 26 city North American farewell run.

events.title: Arizona Diamondbacks vs. Colorado Rockies
events.description: The Diamondbacks host the Colorado Rockies in a National League West series at Chase Field. The retractable roof keeps the ballpark comfortable despite the August heat.

events.title: Downtown Phoenix Farmers Market
events.description: A year round Saturday morning market at Arizona Center featuring more than 90 local growers and businesses selling fresh produce, ready to eat food and artisanal goods, with live music.

events.title: Godsmack, Stone Temple Pilots & Dorothy: The Rise of Rock World Tour (98KUPD UFest)
events.description: Godsmack headlines The Rise of Rock World Tour 2026 with support from Stone Temple Pilots and Dorothy. The Phoenix stop doubles as 98KUPD Presents UFest 2026 at Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre.

events.title: Three Days Grace: Alienation World Tour 2026
events.description: Three Days Grace brings the Alienation World Tour to Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre with support from I Prevail and The Funeral Portrait. This is the band’s only scheduled Arizona stop on the tour.

events.title: KATSEYE: The Wildworld Tour
events.description: Global pop group KATSEYE brings The Wildworld Tour to the Mortgage Matchup Center, featuring six vocalists and full arena scale staging and choreography.

events.title: Rush: Fifty Something
events.description: Rush performs at Desert Diamond Arena as part of the Fifty Something tour marking five decades since the band formed. A second Glendale date follows on December 3, 2026.
